description: This file defines the 'htmlMode' language configuration for the Monaco Editor, including classes and functions for language features like validation, completion, hover, definition, references, and formatting specific to HTML. It also manages web workers for language services.

classes.name: b
classes.description: Manages language worker instances, including creation, disposal, and idle checks.

classes.name: G
classes.description: Handles batch editing operations with change annotations.

classes.name: we
classes.description: Manages change annotations for text edits.

classes.name: Un
classes.description: Represents workspace edit operations, including document changes and text edits.

classes.name: vn
classes.description: Maps severity levels to Monaco editor marker severities.

classes.name: Tn
classes.description: Converts validation diagnostics to Monaco marker format.

classes.name: L
classes.description: Provides hover information in the language service.

methods.name: _stopWorker
methods.description: Stops the web worker if active.

methods.name: _checkIfIdle
methods.description: Checks if the worker has been idle for too long and stops it.

methods.name: _getClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the language service web worker client.

methods.name: getLanguageServiceWorker
methods.description: Returns a promise for the language service worker for given resources.

methods.name: provideCompletionItems
methods.description: Provides completion suggestions at a given position.

methods.name: provideHover
methods.description: Provides hover information at a given position.

methods.name: provideDocumentHighlights
methods.description: Provides document highlights at a given position.

methods.name: provideDefinition
methods.description: Provides definition location for a symbol.

methods.name: provideRenameEdits
methods.description: Provides edits for renaming a symbol.

methods.name: provideDocumentFormattingEdits
methods.description: Provides formatting edits for the entire document.

methods.name: provideDocumentRangeFormattingEdits
methods.description: Provides formatting edits for a specific range.
